# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Confession

---

**44:1** 'O my children, I was the cause of all your suffering and toil upon the earth, for if I had not eaten of the forbidden tree, none of this would have come upon you.'

**44:2** And all her children wept and said: 'Mother, do not condemn yourself, for God is merciful.'

**44:3** And Eve said: 'I confess my sin before God and before all of you, and I hope in God's mercy that he will forgive me.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
